opening.argument: The observable activity is a wallet-setup tutorial. The speaker directs viewers to install MetaMask from the Play Store and then create a password, steps consistent with an operational demonstration rather than a deceptive transaction. The title and description mention earning money and external platforms, but the supplied content does not establish a specific deceptive promise, payment request, or recruitment structure. Nor does it show the speaker instructing viewers to surrender their recovery phrase. Those limits matter: the earning language does not, on this record, turn the demonstrated setup steps into a scam.
